name: Packaging migrants
aliases: Packaging migrants, food contact material migrants, BPA, phthalates, PFAS, migration from packaging
what_is: Chemical compounds that transfer from food packaging into the food itself. They do not appear on the ingredient list but enter the body through food consumption.
why_botia: BOTIA surfaces this risk because substances like BPA, phthalates, and PFAS migrate from plastics, can linings, and wraps into food — especially fatty, acidic, or hot foods. Women are disproportionately exposed through cosmetics and food packaging combined.
can_1: Inform about the risk of chemical migration from packaging materials.
can_2: Flag when a product's packaging type may increase migration risk.
cannot_1: Detect packaging migrants from the ingredient list — they are not declared on the label.
cannot_2: Confirm whether a specific package contains BPA, phthalates, or PFAS.

sources.label: EFSA Phthalates in Food Contact Materials (2019)
